nodes.label: SciIntBench: Measuring LLM Compliance with Research Integrity Norms
nodes.author: Almene De Meran Meguimtsop, Maria Leonor Pacheco, Daniel E. Acuna
nodes.rationale: Benchmark of 810 prompts (270 triplets) across 10 RCR categories and 3 scientific domains; evaluates 16 LLMs on overt/covert adversarial and benign prompts.

nodes.label: Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) Categories
nodes.rationale: Ten categories: Fabrication, Falsification, Plagiarism, Data Integrity, Reproducibility, Peer Review, Authorship, Conflicts of Interest, Human/Animal Subjects, Data Privacy.

nodes.label: Framing Vulnerability Gap
nodes.rationale: Average refusal rate 79.5% for overt adversarial vs. 45.3% for covert adversarial prompts; models fail most when misconduct is covertly framed (how researchers rationalize it).

nodes.label: Pressure-Framed Shortcut Vulnerability
nodes.rationale: Nonmonotonic refusal pattern: Naive/Misguided (90.5%), Intentional Shortcuts (71.6%), Explicit Misconduct (76.2%); models especially vulnerable when misconduct presented as practical compromise.

nodes.label: Refusal Quality Assessment
nodes.rationale: Among refusals: 78.3% corrective (overt), 83.1% corrective (covert); complicit refusals rare (<0.3%); refusal quality differs by prompt type but effect size small.
